observed_residual: KnowledgeFiber.equivalence_classes() currently unions EXACT_ISOMORPHISM, GENERATOR_EQUIVALENCE, OBSERVATIONAL_EQUIVALENCE, ASYMPTOTIC_EQUIVALENCE, QOI_EQUIVALENCE, and APPROXIMATE_REPRESENTATION into one connected-component graph. This can silently upgrade a chain of weaker or differently scoped relations into a stronger global equivalence class, contradicting the Knowledge Atlas rule that agreement at a weaker layer never upgrades to a stronger one.
